name: trustabl-probe
description: Drafts a network allow list for an agent tool and runs it in a network-blocked sandbox to catch runtime problems.
long_description: Trustabl Probe drafts a least-privilege OpenShell network allow list from an agent tool's code and can run the tool in a sandbox with its network blocked, catching crashes, missing dependencies and blocked connection attempts that only show up at runtime. Every finding comes with a fix hint for your agent to apply, so no model or API key is needed. Docker is optional and enables the sandbox; the server checks what is missing and never installs system software itself.

tools.name: probe_check_setup
tools.description: Read-only report of what Probe needs on this machine, with the exact command to fix each missing piece.

tools.name: probe_install
tools.description: Downloads the Probe binary (checksum-verified) and pulls the sandbox images; returns commands for system software instead of running them.

tools.name: probe_scan
tools.description: Scans an agent tool: readiness score, draft network allow list, and findings with fix hints.
